content.text: {"incident_detected":true,"root_cause_hypothesis":"The €10 top-up bonus increases 14-day conversion across the tested channels, but the incremental conversions cost far more than the bonus recipients’ near-term contribution can justify. No channel makes the bonus worthwhile on its own based on the observed economics.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"paid_social €10 bonus: 14-day conversion rate","baseline_value":0.540625,"anomaly_value":0.598057,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT experiment_id, variant, channel, COUNT(*) n, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) conv FROM fct_experiment_users GROUP BY 1,2,3"},{"name":"paid_social bonus incentive cost per incremental conversion","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":102.124286,"unit":"EUR","sql":"WITH x AS (SELECT channel, variant, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) p, AVG(bonus_cost_eur) b FROM fct_experiment_users GROUP BY 1,2), p AS (SELECT a.channel, a.b/(a.p-b.p) incentive_per_incremental FROM x a JOIN x b USING(channel) WHERE a.variant='treatment' AND b.variant='control') SELECT * FROM p"},{"name":"paid_social converted-user 60-day margin, treatment vs BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ltv_to_date, cac_eur FROM agg_unit_economics WHERE months_since_activation <= 36 ORDER BY channel, months_since_activation"}],"recommended_action":"DO_NOT_SHIP","reasoning_summary":"The experiment shows positive conversion lifts in all four channels, but the per-channel incentive cost per incremental conversion is €102.12–€158.46, while observed treatment 60-day margin is negative in every channel and the treatment-versus-control margin difference is negative. Even organic’s observed cumulative contribution margin is €20.42 by its latest reported tenure versus €2 CAC, but this does not overcome the bonus experiment’s negative net-margin effect. Do not roll out the €10 bonus on any channel based on these economics."}
